card.name: Partway through medical terms and acronyms
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of split-up medical terms, often in capitals, such as CARD|IO|VASCULAR, stomatitis/mucositis, RAS or TIA. It fires at the break before the rest of the term.

modes.label: Capitalized heading terms
modes.description: The middle piece of an all-caps cardiovascular heading.

modes.label: Split clinical terms
modes.description: A single letter or short piece that starts or continues a split term or acronym.
modes.example: non-cutaneous<< R>>AS mutation-positive malignancies, and QT

modes.label: Cardiovascular words
modes.description: The start of the word cardiovascular in a study name.
modes.example: Transatlantic Active Surveillance on<< Cardio>>vascular Safety of Etonogestrel

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing with word pieces like 'inter' or 'flo' and away from 'upper' variants.
card.plain: It lights up when a long medical term or acronym is broken into pieces and the middle is being read.
